judgement.summary: The plan is an editorial journey through Ines’s preparation-led kitchen, supported by a 3D jar shelf and practical apprenticeship and workshop pages. Its greatest weakness is that the 3D illustrates the story without becoming a continuing object whose changes carry the narrative.
